lessons: Cause: stages.py regression_result parses the whole stdout as one JSON object. At base, main() printed 'claude: system, package @anthropic-ai/claude-code' to stdout before the JSON, so base decoded as null even with rc 1. The JSON line must be the only thing on stdout.

In tests/regress_provider_install_broken_binary.py, wrap the clutch.__main__.main(["provider","install","claude"], ...) call in contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) (stderr can stay as is), then print only json.dumps({"regression_result": ...}).

Redo the clutch/__main__.py work from the merge base: in handle_install, the pnpm argv gets f"--allow-build={package}", and a named install raises runner.Refusal when status.version is None (exit 2). Add the refusal to the install exits= help. Review found this approach sound.

Redo the tests/unit/test_install_verb.py changes: update the codex argv assertion to include --allow-build=@openai/codex, and add a fake-exec test where claude --version returns (1, "", "Error: claude native binary not installed.\n"), asserting rc 2 and 'claude' in stderr.

Before you commit, run the reproducer at the base commit with only the carried file overlaid. stdout must be exactly {"regression_result": "defect"} with a nonzero exit, and at head exactly {"regression_result": "pass"} with exit 0.
